peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 61.8% above its local comparables; 141 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (98.9): 10.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 400 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Initial resale-wave effect: 7 of the 10 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Jul 2025–Jun 2026), so this figure is not yet a sustained rate; sustained activity remains settling. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,400,000 ($2,563 psf, 936 sq ft; 5 resales, Dec 2023–Nov 2025); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,584 psf (range $1,481–2,683); 61.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $917,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave

lines.statement: Settling: fewer than 12 months of resales after the first resale wave, so sustained activity is not yet measurable. Observed activity is shown. First resale wave from Jul 2025 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. 3 months available from Jul 2026; measurable with data to Jun 2027. Observed: 10.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 480 m, Newton MRT about 880 m; closer than 216 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 160 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 260 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 500 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,240 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 460 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 740 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 950 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,380 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,470 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,700 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 2,000 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 400 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 58 new sales and 983 resales (1,041 purchases); new sales were 5.6% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 983 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 261 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 983 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,052 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.6%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
